brief: A desk caddy with a bin, dressed with a stapler and a coffee mug.

requirements.evidence: Piece 0,0,0 full base with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-compartment full depth bin) – provides caddy storage; capped and locked.

finish.summary: Built single-cell desk caddy with 2-compartment bin and coffee mug. Stapler dressing unavailable – catalog has no stapler prop; build is otherwise complete and verified (mesh clear, caps locked).

events.text: Your desk caddy is next — I'll get a bin and dress it with your mug and stapler.
